remarks: Just steps from the sand, this captivating Compo Beach retreat delivers the coastal lifestyle buyers dream about-effortless, elegant, and designed to be lived in year-round. Set above the flood zone on .52 acres of exquisitely landscaped grounds, this lovingly maintained 4-bedroom, 4-full-bath home feels both refined and relaxed, with outdoor living woven into every experience. Sunlight streams through expansive windows and doors, creating a seamless flow between indoors and out. The open main level invites connection, anchored by a welcoming living room with stone fireplace, a sunlit dining area, and well-designed kitchen that opens to an expansive Azek deck-ideal for summer dinners and sunset gatherings. A casual family room and coveted screened-in porch overlook the grounds, offering peaceful spaces to unwind. A main floor bedroom with access to a renovated hall bath provides flexibility, while a mudroom and direct access to the two-car garage add everyday ease. Upstairs, the primary suite is a private escape with vaulted beamed ceilings, a spa-like renovated bath with oversized shower, and a large walk-in closet. Two additional bedrooms, a light-filled study area, laundry room, and a dramatic bonus/rec room with soaring ceilings complete the second floor. The lower level gym provides walk out to patio with cozy firepit and outdoor shower. Full House Generator. Room for pool. Natural Gas, City Water and Sewer. Easy for commuters - located minutes to train and I-95
